verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence states whether customer documents are used to train Datalab's models, and no training opt-out or no-training policy is documented. The Enterprise on-prem/air-gapped deployment and the Team-plan BAA/DPA are general data-privacy options. Neither is a documented control that keeps data out of model training, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
